Vocational Excellence Award - A Recognition of a Noble Cause and a Worthy Person
Rotary Club of Bombay Seaface | 19 September 2026

19 September 2026 was a proud and memorable day for the Rotary Club of Bombay Seaface (RCBS), as the Club honoured Dr Jatin Nandlal Valia, a homeopathic physician and a committed humanitarian, with the Vocational Excellence Award during its Club meeting.
Through the Nandlal H. Valia Research & Charitable Trust, Dr Valia has dedicated every Sunday since March 2012 to serving the socio-economically disadvantaged Adivasi tribal communities of Talasari. Located approximately 65 miles from Mumbai, Talasari continues to face significant social and economic challenges, with communities that remain far behind the progress experienced elsewhere.
